title: tectaria zollingeri
intro: Tectaria zollingeri, commonly known as the Zollinger's fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Tectaria zollingeri include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
